digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and sync
propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF through production codec paths without lossy plain-text fallback
Data Center Markdown descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup through production codec paths without content erosion or length decay
Echo-safety layer using ADR-0026 per-binding baseline plus change-gated rich_sha must suppress unchanged second-pass reconciliation and flag concurrent edits
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive origin-gated outbound normalization when rebar-originated reconciliation follows Jira-authored edits
DC pandoc subprocess must bound work per field with timeout fallback to identity, GPL/SBOM obligations recorded
Append-only comment ID map must enable bidirectional comment sync codec-routed through the same rich-text codec as descriptions without edit/delete mutations
